source.name: Clear Body
source.originalDescription: Reduces the duration of hindrance effects by 10% when enemy players are nearby. The more enemy players there are, the more the hindrance effects are reduced, up to a maximum of 5 enemy players (50% max).
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Clear Body には、直接ダメージや単純移動以外の特殊効果を検出していません。

damageFormula.trueDescription: Reduces the duration of hindrance effects by 10% when enemy players are nearby. The more enemy players there are, the more the hindrance effects are reduced, up to a maximum of 5 enemy players (50% max).

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, striking with an increased area of attack. When a boosted attack hits, the cooldown of Iron Defense, Meteor Mash or Gyro Ball is reduced by 10%. If multiple targets are hit, the cooldown is instead reduced by 20%.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は 通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる。

source.name: Compute and Crush
source.originalDescription: Quickly analyzes the position of nearby enemies, granting a shield based on the number of enemies analyzed and become unstoppable. When 2 or fewer enemies are analyzed, lunge towards the enemy with the lowest HP, leaving it unable to act for 0.8s and dealing damage to it thrice, with the third hit dealing damage based on the target's missing HP. If an enemy is knocked out by this move, the user recovers 30% of its Unite Move gauge. If there are three or more analyzed, lunge toward the enemy with the lowest HP, dealing damage to nearby enemies and creating a wall around the user. If a wall is created, Compute and Crash may be used again to take down the wall. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 30% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Compute and Crush は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、妨害無効になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、現在HP・最大HP・減少HPなどを参照する、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ、壁・地形・草むらなどと相互作用する。
